question: Where is the left ring finger bound in this mudra?
premises: vāmānāmāñcabadhnīyāt commands binding left ring finger
dakṣāṅguṣṭhasya mūlake locates right thumb root
inference: The left ring finger is bound at the root of the right thumb.
plain_english: One should bind the left ring finger at the root of the right thumb.
